title: Markdown pages download in Safari instead of displaying
description: Every site serves its Markdown twins (/x/index.md) as text/markdown. Safari downloads that type, so the View as Markdown link and shared Markdown links download a file instead of showing raw text in the browser (reported by Ryan on Machines on Machines, 2026-11-04). Expected: a person following the link sees raw Markdown in the browser, on any site. Suggested fix: send text/plain; charset=utf-8 to browsers, and keep text/markdown for a client whose Accept header prefers it, using the same qualityOf negotiation as amplify/publication/redirect-and-index.js, in a viewer-response function so the cached object and the content negotiation stay unchanged. No Content-Disposition attachment. Needs a real Safari check on iPad and Mac after deploy; a Gherkin scenario for both Accept cases.
